CSP10 preparation uses starport-catalog-routing, branch codex/starport-catalog-routing, at d3689cd. Starmap registry commit 008ddc8e6 adds two required HTTP checks. Both worktrees are clean. Use GOWORK=/tmp/csp10-host-integration.work for this unpublished pair.

The inference policy proof records the current repair. Missing or denied models return 404. Known but unavailable chat models return 503. Unsupported chat, streaming, and embedding operations return 400 for permitted callers. Account policy prevents capability errors from revealing private offerings.

Final affected checks pass 873 race events with one optional skip. Vet, lint, and new-source prose checks pass. The verifier unit suite passes 81 tests. Source verification is terminal. These results do not qualify the complete task.

The disclosure registry now requires 27 checks. All 27 disclosure checks pass against the current local pair. Published-pair qualification remains required.

The removal proof records live HTTP and Python SDK transitions at 7034eb2. Final server checks pass 529 events with one optional skip. Vet, lint, and the full SDK smoke script pass.

The SDK roster proof adds 60 transition requests across all four pinned SDKs. It repairs an absent streaming fingerprint that TypeScript rejected. Final affected checks pass 586 events with two skips. SDK qualification passes separately.

The complete race command passes 999 events with three skips. Separate SDK and Valkey runs cover those skipped checks. The acceptance gate passes six of 29 selected subcases. Twenty-three lack registered checks and remain unverified.

Next, map existing tests to those missing requirements and add tests where coverage is incomplete. Register only complete behavior contracts, then rerun acceptance before review. No verification process remains active.
